lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Harper Lane, twenty-four, a night-shift nurse, gasps awake on the hospital bed, her chest wound bandaged.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Cole Whitmore, thirty-two, billionaire CEO of Whitmore Shipping pretending to be a mechanic, drops his coffee in shock.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: You're alive, Harper, you're really alive!

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: The doctors said my heart stopped, Cole, I felt everything go dark.

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.text: Mia Lane, seventeen, high-school student still recovering from her heart surgery, rushes in with her left arm in a sling.

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.text: Harper, the doctors just came by with your post-op blood work results!

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: What is it, Mia, is my heart failing again?

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.text: No, you're pregnant, Harper, you're going to be a mother!

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Jake Whitmore, twenty-nine, head of sales, stands in handcuffs alongside his mother Diane as reporters swarm them outside the building.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: Diane Whitmore, fifty-eight, board member, glares at the cameras as federal agents drag her toward a squad car for poisoning Evelyn.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: If Harper survived my bullet, mother, she's going to take everything we built.
